name: dsh-proposal-gate
description: Human review channel for DeepSeek Harness: models submit structured change proposals via tools; review/apply/verify exist only as a human command; durable store with append-only audit ledger and stale-base_version refusal.

dshCompatibility.note: deepseek-harness is pre-release with no compatibility promise; re-verify against newer commits before upgrading. Bare-imports @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools at runtime (provided by the harness install).
